Trace, implement and test: Take in input in given format ( string : code )

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
# Take in input in given format ( string : code )
# check for code digits
# if sum of square of digits is even add last two character at the top of string
# else add first character at the last.

# Test Case
# abcd:1234,bcdgfhf:127836,sdjks:1245
# output : cdab cdgfhfbc kssdj


input = input()
list_of_inputs = input.split(',')
new_list = []
for inputs in list_of_inputs:
    sum = 0
    letter, code = inputs.split(":")
    for digit in code:
        sum += int(digit)**2

    if sum % 2 == 0:
        new_list.append(letter[-2:]+letter[:-2])
    else:
        new_list.append(letter[1:]+letter[0])

print(' '.join(new_list))
